After thoroughly searching through the Settings application, I was unable to locate a specific "Dim screen when inactive" toggle or setting. 

The Power section contains the following relevant settings:
- **Screen Blank**: Controls when the screen turns off after inactivity (currently set to 5 minutes)
- **Automatic Suspend**: Controls when the computer pauses/suspends after inactivity (currently set to Off)

However, there is no separate toggle specifically labeled "Dim screen when inactive" in the standard Settings interface of this Ubuntu/GNOME system.

This setting may:
1. Not exist in this particular system configuration
2. Be integrated into the Screen Blank functionality
3. Require accessing advanced system configuration tools (like dconf-editor or gsettings command line)

The closest available setting is "Screen Blank" which controls screen behavior during inactivity, but it doesn't provide a separate dimming toggle as requested.
